sents.en: The telephone was invented in 1876.
The first ones didn't have numbers.
You had to talk to an operator.
You told the operator whom to call.
Dial phones came out in the 1890s.
People didn't need operators.
sents.ko: 사람들은 더 이상 교환원이 필요하지 않았어요.

sents.en: AT&T invented phones with buttons in 1963.
Many phones send sounds over wires.
They are landline phones.
Mobile phones don't use wires.
They send sounds through the air.
Telephones let people talk to each other.
sents.ko: 전화기는 사람들이 서로 이야기하게 해 줘요.

sents.en: Carrie calls her grandma.
Telephones let people call for help.
Max dials 9-1-1.
Smartphones are small computers.
They have cameras, games, and more!
sents.ko: 카메라와 게임, 그 밖에도 많은 게 들어 있어요!

sents.en: Oh, how interesting!
Phones, they used to be so big.
But now they're so small, they can fit in your hand.
sents.ko: 그런데 지금은 아주 작아서 손에 들어와요.

sents.en: What do you think? What will happen to phones in the future?
sents.ko: 어떻게 생각하나요? 전화기는 앞으로 어떻게 될까요?

sents.en: Will it be smaller? Or bigger?
Think about it for today.
Don't forget to use a phone. Good-bye.
sents.ko: 전화기 쓰는 걸 잊지 마세요. 안녕!
